C++ — Stream2D

This feature is available only on camera models, capture modes, and firmware that provide Stream2D. The SDK returns the H264 data produced by the camera without decoding it.

Correspond `stream2d.cpp`for management Stream2D Letters and trustees WebRTC Session.

API Reference

Purpose: Query activity streams and peer Number.

Parameters

Name Type Description

std::string

Camera address.

Stream2DStatus &

Returns: bool.

startStream2DRtcSession(ip, options, onFrame, session)

Purpose: _Other Organiser WebRTC Receive sessions, frame by frame H264 Annex-B Original stream.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

options

const Stream2DRtcSessionOptions &

Value of options.

onFrame

const Stream2DFrameCallback &

Callback that receives H264 frames.

session

std::unique_ptr<Stream2DRtcSession> &

WebRTC session.

Returns: bool.

stopStream2DRtcSession(session)

Purpose: Actively stop a hosting session while cleaning the cameraend peer and local RTC.

Parameters

Name Type Description

session

const std::unique_ptr<Stream2DRtcSession> &

WebRTC session.

Returns: None. startStream2DRtcSession creates a WebRTC session and delivers H264 Annex-B access units through the callback. The SDK does not decode or re-encode the video. fps is passed to the camera request. Stop the session with stopStream2DRtcSession(session).

Example: Save H264

TFTech::Stream2DRtcSessionOptions options;
options.fps = 60;

std::ofstream output("stream.h264", std::ios::binary);
std::unique_ptr<TFTech::Stream2DRtcSession> session;
bool ok = TFTech::EpicEye::startStream2DRtcSession(
    ip,
    options,
    [&](const TFTech::Stream2DRtcFrame& frame) {
        output.write(
            reinterpret_cast<const char*>(frame.sample.data()),
            static_cast<std::streamsize>(frame.sample.size()));
    },
    session);

// Only stop the session at the end of use peer.
TFTech::EpicEye::stopStream2DRtcSession(session);
